purpose: Fix the VLM's float16 overflow crash and its GPU memory peak on the 24 GB Mac (Apple M5 Pro, MPS).
limitations: 'Facts read' is a rough recall measure (share of each screenshot's rendered fact values found in the VLM output), not the field-accuracy metric the tracker asks for; it does not separate missing, wrong and invented facts.
Raw VLM outputs were kept in a temporary folder that was later cleared; numbers below were copied from the run logs printed during the session.

float16_overflow.symptom: On the turn 3 partial CloudWatch screenshot every generated token was '!' (1400 characters, the token limit). Both extraction attempts failed after about 175 s each, so the evaluation failed.
float16_overflow.cause: float16's range (max about 65,000) overflowed inside the model on this image; Qwen2.5-VL was trained in bfloat16.
float16_overflow.fix: Load the VLM in bfloat16 on the GPU (_image_dtype in image_model.py; HF_IMAGE_DTYPE=float16 restores the old behaviour).
float16_overflow.result: The same screenshot reads in 71 s with no crash.

judge_on_bfloat16_readings.misses: turn 2, 3 and 5 partial graded Weak. Turn 3 first failed grounding because the judge wrote an absence ('no direct AttachUserPolicy call shown') as its key fact; Weak verdicts now clear such a copy instead of failing.

gpu_memory_peak.measurement: torch.mps.current_allocated_memory (live tensors) and torch.mps.driver_allocated_memory (Metal total, including the allocator's cached free blocks), sampled every 0.05-0.1 s; turn 2 CloudWatch then CloudTrail screenshot.

before.when: CloudTrail answer generation (live tensors 7.6 GB at that moment)

gpu_memory_peak.cause: Generation grows the key/value cache one token at a time; the MPS allocator kept every freed buffer until generation ended. CloudWatch screenshots peak around 11.7 GB, which is why an earlier 15 GB measurement on CloudWatch did not show it.
gpu_memory_peak.output_unchanged: Generated token counts identical before and after (CloudWatch 382, CloudTrail 332); the fix returns memory only.

other_models.coach_qwen2.5_1.5b: 900 tokens in 87 s; live 3.1 GB, driver 5.2 GB; no fix needed
other_models.security_model: runs in llama.cpp (Metal), not PyTorch MPS
